Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through your inference requirements and current bottlenecks. As promised, I’ve attached the recording and the slide deck so you can share with the team:

Quick recap / next steps I noted:

- Security ask: SOC2 evidence and data retention controls — we discussed Private deployment options

If it’s useful, I can set up a short 15-minute Q&A next week to go over any follow-up questions from engineering or security. I have availability: Tue 2/16 10–11am PT, Wed 2/17 2–4pm PT, or Thu 2/18 9–10am PT. Feel free to pick a slot: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/redwood-qa-15min

Appreciate the time — happy to loop in Dylan from solutions if you want a deeper bench on sched.
